messages:
incident-bot: PAGERDUTY: high-severity alert fired -> Edge TLS handshake error rate spike in eu-west-1 (PD: INC-2024-773).
incident-bot: symptom summary: sudden increase in TLS handshake failures (handshake_timeout / unknown_ca) from edge proxies -> downstream 502s for some customers.

DevOps OnCall: acked and triaging. Taking lead until SRE joins.

Alex S: on call, taking ownership. First check: are we seeing cert expiry or validation errors? Maria, can you pull the edge cert chain errors?

Maria C: metrics: tls_errors_eu_west increased from ~0.7% -> 11% starting 00:42 UTC. Logs show a lot of `SSL: certificate verify failed` and `unknown CA` in proxy logs. Not seeing typical openssl EOF signatures.

Kevin L: running `openssl s_client -connect edge-eu.example:443 -servername customer.example.com -showcerts` against a handful of edge nodes. On healthy nodes we get full chain. On some nodes the server returns only leaf cert (missing intermediate CA). Example:
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = *.example.com
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
verify return:1
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=*.example.com
   i:/CN=Acme Intermediate CA
---
```

Kevin L: reproduces from host i-0ef12bad (eu-edge-12). That host's cert bundle missing the intermediate.

Alex S: origin of cert rotation 00:20 UTC? Product Support, any cert rotations or CA changes today?

Product Support: we rolled the leaf cert at 00:15 UTC for scheduled renewal. The automation should have uploaded full bundle to all edges. No manual changes afterwards.

Network Infra Bot: Deploy pipeline status: cert-rollout job succeeded for 42/50 edges, 8 edges reported flaky agent timeouts and left in MAINT state.

Alex S: aha — partial rollout. That plus a Route53 weighted policy change at 00:40 UTC shifted ~30% more traffic to eu-west which coincided with older edges receiving more sessions -> clients hit nodes with incomplete chain and failed to validate -> handshake errors.

DevOps OnCall: mitigation plan: 1) remove affected edges from LB rotation, 2) re-upload full cert bundle to missing nodes, 3) restore rotation, 4) roll forward to ensure parity. Also prepare status page update.

DevOps OnCall: running check to enumerate nodes missing intermediate: `for n in $(cat eu-edge-nodes); do openssl s_client -connect $n:443 -servername test.example.com -showcerts | grep -q "Acme Intermediate CA" || echo $n; done`

DevOps OnCall: found 8 nodes: eu-edge-{12,14,19,20,21,22,23,24}. Deregistering from ALB target group now.

DevOps OnCall: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn $TG_EU_EDGE --targets Id=i-0ef12bad ...` -> done. Traffic immediately rebalanced.

Maria C: TLS error rate dropped from 11% -> 2.1% within 60s. User impact falling.

Alex S: good. Next step re-upload bundle. Who has playbooks for cert push?

Kevin L: `ansible-playbook playbooks/push-cert-bundle.yml -l eu-edge-missing -e cert=/artifacts/certs/2024-10/leaf_with_intermediate.pem` (runs in parallel).

Kevin L: bundles pushed to 8 hosts. Restarting proxy service: `systemctl restart redwood-proxy` and verifying.

Kevin L: re-check `openssl s_client` -> all show full chain. Re-registering one-by-one with 45s observation window.

DevOps OnCall: re-register commands executed. Monitoring metrics.

Maria C: health and error graphs look stable. TLS errors at baseline ~0.6%. Latency normalizing.

PagerDuty-bot: Escalation timer canceled; incident acknowledged and being handled.

Alex S: Product Support publish status: "Partial edge TLS validation failures in EU due to incomplete certificate bundles on a subset of edge hosts; traffic failed over and affected hosts patched. No customer keys compromised. We are monitoring." Posting now.

Product Support: posted. Also flagging impacted customers (IDs pulled from request logs) for proactive outreach.

Jamie R: joining. Preliminary RCA pointer: cert-rollout pipeline didn't retry hosts with transient agent timeouts; those hosts remained in older state (bundles not applied). The weighted DNS change increased traffic to the stale cohort which revealed the hole.

Alex S: action items during incident: 1) patch hosts (done), 2) re-register and monitor (done), 3) customer notifications (Product Support). Next: follow-up items for postmortem.

DevOps OnCall: running `aws route53 list-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZXYZ` to validate weighted records. The weight change at 00:40 was applied by `traffic-manager` job. Will add rollback protective guard in pipeline.

Maria C: creating incident ticket notes and attaching graphs + affected request IDs.

Kevin L: adding a quick preflight to cert-rollout job: verify `openssl s_client -showcerts` result contains expected intermediate, otherwise fail fast and retry. Will open PR.

Jamie R: also recommend modifying rollout: mark hosts as NOT_READY if agent fails during cert push and prevent route53 weight increases that would shift substantial traffic to them until they report Healthy. Add a pre-weight-shift canary check.

Product Support: estimating customer impact: ~18 minutes of elevated TLS failures for ~9% of EU traffic; roughly 1200 customer sessions saw failures; several enterprise customers reported degraded API traffic. Preparing notification templates.

PagerDuty-bot: incident INC-2024-773 resolved by Alex S. Status set to resolved.

Alex S: summary for postmortem: root cause = partial certificate bundle rollout left subset of edge proxies without intermediate CA; contributing factor = Route53 weighted traffic shift that increased traffic to stale nodes; detection = alert from TLS error threshold; mitigation = deregister affected nodes, push bundle, restart proxies, re-register.

Alex S: follow-ups: (1) make cert-rollout idempotent + retry on agent timeout, (2) add cert-chain verification pre/post rollout, (3) block major DNS weight shifts to any cohort with non-healthy check, (4) run a one-week audit of edge cert parity. Scheduling RCA sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

Product Support: customer comms drafted. Will wait for RCA before sending final note.

Kevin L: opened PR #4892 to add `openssl s_client` verification step to the pipeline.

Maria C: attaching logs and traces to the ticket. Thanks team. Will close after RCA draft. :thumbsup:
